success.description: Spell power. You must light a candle, lantern, or other light source as you cast this spell. While this card is recharging, anytime you or an ally within close range of you suffer corruption, you may remove 1 recharge token from this card to reduce corruption by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

chaosStar.description: When this card recharges, you suffer 1 corruption

success.description: Spell effect: You must light a candle, lantern, or other light source as you cast this spell. Special: This card recharges at dawn. Effect: The light of Hysh shields you, burning away corruption. While this card is recharging, anytime you suffer corruption, you may remove any number of recharge tokens from this card to reduce that corruption by an equal amount (to a minimum of 1).

chaosStar.description: When this card recharges, you suffer 2 corruption
